name: chatgpt-web-bridge
description: A local-first Codex toolkit series: visible Web LLM bridge, browser watchdog, multi-link status, and read-only GitHub workspace diagnostics.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to web AIs and inspect browser/GitHub workspaces safely.
interface.longDescription: Codex Bridge Toolkit Series contains the visible Web LLM Conversation Bridge, a read-only Edge/Chrome browser watchdog, human-readable multi-link status, and a read-only GitHub workspace toolkit. The bridge connects Codex tasks to ChatGPT Web or DeepSeek Web without exposing browser ports or routing IDs, verifies the destination before every send, and supports one-shot, manual link, bounded relay, and continuous goal modes. The watchdog never switches tabs or resends messages. The GitHub toolkit never pulls, pushes, commits, or contacts GitHub automatically. No passwords, cookies, API keys, private endpoints, or hidden chain-of-thought are collected.
defaultPrompt: List the Codex Bridge toolkit series.
Open the two-column web bridge panel inside this Codex conversation.
Connect this Codex conversation to a visible web AI.
Check the browser watchdog or current GitHub workspace safely.
